_comment: IronMonkey persona manifest (Phase 2 step H11). NOT read by Conpot -- the
0.6.0 loader only looks at template.xml and <protocol>/<protocol>.xml, so
this directory is invisible to it. It is read by the Conpot forwarder
asset_type/vendor/model seed the uuid5 of the x-ics-asset node IronPot
writes, so a wrong entry here does not just mislabel a row -- it merges
two devices into one graph identity, or splits one into two.
Roster for this persona (see template.xml for the full rationale):
MicroLogix 1400   modbus, enip, http   -- the plant PLC
S7-1200 + CP1243  s7comm, iec104, snmp -- chemical dosing skid and the
The S7-1200 and its CP 1243-1 are ONE asset on purpose: a CP is a module
of the CPU, not another box, so s7comm and iec104 carry the same identity
and collapse to a single x-ics-asset.
`services` keys are the forwarder's own data_type values, not port names.
`default` covers every service with no entry of its own; here that is the
plant PLC, because it is the device most sessions land on.
label: Municipal drinking-water treatment plant, filtration and chemical dosing
